full_config_snapshot.description: H8 Exploratory: Pure positive + 2 HP. Canon+ and 2 hard positives, no negatives. Image-using track (brief-text-image).
full_config_snapshot.note: Exploratory follow-up to Phase 2c. Tests HP scaling in pure-positive context (no Canon-). Motivated by finding that negatives degrade performance. Related to preregistered H12 (HP:HN Ratio).
